'''Maki Salak''' was a [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] environmental extremist during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. He strongly protested the killing of the crab-like [[Rikknit/Legends|rikknits]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. Salak once tried to destroy an entire shipment of the [[ji rikknit]] intoxicant in [[Karsten High Port]], but was apprehended and sent to solitary confinement.<ref name="CCW" />
